text_block_list.text:
After Голд Сити finishes the Satsuki Sho,
a few
voices within the audience can be
heard
commenting on her running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems they might come around to
recognizing
the "real Голд Сити" if she
keeps up this
momentum. Her hopes
remain high.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Next, she'll win the Japanese Derby to
claim the
reputation of strongest in her
generation!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
